$comment: This plugin does NOT bundle these MCP servers — a plugin's .mcp.json can only ship stdio servers it launches itself, and every connector below is a remote OAuth connector managed in claude.ai / Claude Code settings. This file documents them as required prerequisites (see README.md and SETUP.md) so the dependency is visible in the plugin repo; it intentionally defines no servers of its own. Indeed/Dice below are examples — swap in whatever job-board MCP(s) you actually connect, and update context/config.md with the real tool bindings.

requiredConnectors.name: Notion
requiredConnectors.purpose: The Job Search Pipeline database — read/write for every skill in this plugin.
requiredConnectors.setup: Connect via claude.ai connector settings, or `claude mcp` / /mcp in an interactive session.

requiredConnectors.name: Google Drive
requiredConnectors.purpose: Live read of the master resume (authoritative candidate facts) used by daily-sweep Step 0 and apply-assist.

requiredConnectors.name: Gmail
requiredConnectors.purpose: Read-only email reconciliation (rejection/interview/offer detection) and LinkedIn job-alert email discovery, used by daily-sweep Part 2.

requiredConnectors.name: Indeed job-search MCP
requiredConnectors.purpose: Primary job-board discovery source, used by daily-sweep Part 1.

requiredConnectors.name: Dice job-search MCP
requiredConnectors.purpose: Secondary job-board discovery source with a hard salary-floor filter, used by daily-sweep Part 1a.

requiredConnectors.name: Chrome MCP / Playwright / Claude Chrome extension
requiredConnectors.purpose: Reading full job descriptions and filling ATS forms in apply-assist. Fallback order: Chrome MCP, then Playwright, then the Claude Chrome extension.
requiredConnectors.setup: Chrome MCP and the Claude Chrome extension are configured per the user's global CLAUDE.md; Playwright ships as a separate plugin/MCP server.
